svg.title: Captured CNA weakness context
svg.desc: 127 main CVE contexts; 110 with supplied CWE IDs. Each CWE bar counts unique CVE contexts; one CVE can appear in several CWE bars. Missing/status bars are explicit. Weakness and CAPEC mappings do not establish observed attacks, devices or actor responsibility.
